Find the parametric equations of the hyperbola shown above given that its asymptotes are $y=\pm \frac{\sqrt{7}}{5}x.$

feedback.problem:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/multivariable/14093685/assets/aa1d2d880a575def3e4ca91ac0504ba82fca1ac0908d0fb681bb12e2c81c1081.png)

The quarter-hyperbola above is defined by the parametric equations 

$$
x=2\operatorname{sec}⁡t,\,y=\operatorname{tan}⁡t.
$$

What is the domain of the parameter $t?$
feedback.worked_solution:
The parametric equations of the full hyperbola are

$$
x=2\operatorname{sec}⁡t,\,y=\operatorname{tan}⁡t,\,t\in [-\pi ,\pi ],\,t\ne \pm \frac{\pi }{2}.
$$

To restrict the parameterization to a quarter-hyperbola, we refer to the diagram below.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/multivariable/14093685/assets/ba7e04b9bba38060ab8320365a8b4c88d1dd9f31262ff021ac8b4c65c5d23862.png)

We can see that if we restrict $t$ to $[-\pi ,-\frac{\pi }{2}),$ we get only the quarter-hyperbola.

Therefore, the parametric equations that describe the required quarter-hyperbola are

$$
x=2\operatorname{sec}⁡t,\,y=\operatorname{tan}⁡t,\,t\in [-\pi ,-\frac{\pi }{2}).
$$
